channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says escalation ‘unlikely’, Iran demands ‘surrender’
item.description: US President Donald Trump made the remarks after meeting Qatar's prime minister in Washington, DC.

item.title: Trump, Rubio defend Hegseth as impeachment bid nears
item.description: President Trump has lashed out at efforts to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the US war on Iran.

item.title: After meeting Qatar PM, Trump calls Iran war ‘effectively over’ militarily
item.description: Iranian officials dismissed Trump's remarks as 'fake news' after he suggested keeping the 'status quo'.

item.title: Saudi Arabia reports new attack on key East-West pipeline
item.description: The oil pipeline runs through the desert to the coast and is essential for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
item.description: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

item.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
item.description: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.
